title: Supplier Onboarding Support Agent with EN+GER/SP/IT/FR/POR

details.jobDescription:
• Respond to Supplier Onboarding tickets (“Contact Us”) and support interactions captured in Pega.

  • Provide navigation and process support across Ariba SLP and Relish.

  • Guide suppliers through standard onboarding steps, form completion and documented data requirements.

  • Conduct supplier walkthroughs for standard onboarding scenarios, including scheduled support where language or process assistance is needed.

  • Provide basic field guidance when selection logic is documented and does not require interpretation of a non-standard business scenario.

  • Resolve common invitation, access, login, navigation and form-completion issues.

  • Provide onboarding status updates and explain the documented next action required to progress the request.

  • Identify missing information and clearly communicate what the supplier needs to provide.

  • Use approved knowledge, decision trees and scripts to provide consistent support across regions and languages.

  • Escalate non-standard setup questions, urgent requests, stuck/problematic onboarding and issues requiring business-rule interpretation to Regional Tier 2 Supplier Onboarding.

  • Capture complete ticket notes, issue category and disposition in Pega to support handoff quality, reporting and continuous improvement.

  • Fluent German/French/Italian/Spanish/Portuguese and English (written and spoken).

  • 1-3 years of experience in customer support, supplier enablement, shared services, service desk or a comparable high-volume support environment.

  • Strong customer-service orientation and confidence supporting external suppliers as well as internal client requesters.

  • Ability to become highly proficient in Pega, Ariba SLP and Relish; experience with enterprise workflow or supplier platforms is preferred.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain process requirements simply and consistently.

  • Ability to follow documented business rules, knowledge and escalation criteria without over-escalating standard questions.

  • Strong documentation discipline and comfort working against ticket queues, SLAs, quality measures and productivity targets.

*Hybrid working model: 2 days per week from the office and 3 days per week working from home (WFH), in line with business requirements and company policy.
